newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust cutting 24 trader jobs - source.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust cutting 24 trader jobs - source.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp is cutting about 24 government bond traders jobs as it merges the trading desk with its derivatives trading operations, someone familiar with the situation said.
There is a great deal of overlap between Treasury and derivatives clients, prompting the move to combine the desks, the source said.
Some of the government bond traders not being laid off are heading to other departments, the source said.
Trading Treasuries and other debt is not as profitable as it used to be, the source said, noting technology and abundant capacity to handle the trading are affecting the market.
The source said Bankers Trust is investing in other opportunities, including the trading of inflation-linked bond products.
